description: Full site audit report for one domain, for client reports, vendor reviews or a pre-launch check. Runs every check (TLS from CT logs + live probe, DNS/DNSSEC/CAA, registration expiry and transfer lock, SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS, security headers) plus HTTP->HTTPS redirect, www/apex consistency, RFC 9116 security.txt, robots.txt and sitemap. Returns the A-F grade and score (same weights as domain_grade), an action plan sorted critical > high > medium > low where each item has the exact fix and effort, and every raw section. Use domain_grade for just the letter. Fails (not charged) if 3+ core checks fail. Read-only; about 5-15 s. Costs $2 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
